about_the_game:
A story of secrets, lies, and murder.
In Kayotica, you play as April—a clever but manipulative student caught in a web of friendship, rivalry, and dark crimes. What begins as ordinary campus life quickly turns into a mystery of betrayal, hidden truths, and a shocking murder.

Can you solve the mystery, or will you become the next victim?

About the Game

Kayotica is a choice-driven visual novel full of suspense and drama. Each decision you make changes April’s relationships, her fate, and the truth you uncover.

Features

  • Murder Mystery – Uncover the truth behind a deadly crime.

  • Multiple Choices & Endings – Your decisions matter and lead to different outcomes.

  • Beautiful Art – Characters and backgrounds with rich detail.

  • AI challenge – Where you talk with an AI character to dynamically complete the scene.

  • Dynamic Relationships – Build or break bonds with your choices.

  • Replay Value – Explore new paths and hidden truths on every playthrough.

A visual novel where love, lies, and murder meet. Welcome to Kayotica.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 260X or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
